paragraphs: The X7 xDrive40d uses the B57 — a 3.0-litre inline-six diesel. It was fitted from the X7's launch in 2018 across the G07 generation, which includes the 2022 facelift and continues to the present day. The B57 is part of BMW's modern B-series engine family, which is known for significant improvements in reliability over the older N-series engines.
about.boldParagraph: The X7 xDrive40d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
